detail.longDescription: Hi fediverse. We're AIHostBox, a small team (the same people run GGameHost, a game server host) that runs open-source AI apps like Open WebUI, Flowise and AnythingLLM as managed instances on plain CPU servers. We'll post self-hosting notes, licence gotchas and the odd thing we broke. Not planning to fill your timeline with offers. # introduction # selfhosted # OpenWebUI
